<thought>To find the required template, I will search the template catalog for a forward reaction that breaks an ester (C‑O single bond) and forms an aldehyde (aliphatic hydroxyl functional group is also formed in the product). This matches the DIBAL‑H reduction description. I will query the database with these criteria and then return the mapped reaction SMILES and the template ID.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ester"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["aldehyde"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C-O"],
    "bonds_order_changed": null,
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
